dedupe_keys.name: transims transportation analysis and simulation system version 5 0 open source agent based travel routing and microsimulation suite

description: TRANSIMS, the Transportation Analysis and Simulation System, is an open-source suite for routing individual travellers through a transport network and simulating their movement vehicle by vehicle. The source archive read on 2026-09-28 through Software Heritage, a copy of the project's SourceForge repository, holds version 5.0, last revised in January 2014, with programs for building road and transit networks, converting trip tables, choosing modes, routing travel plans, microsimulation, link delay and volume summaries, subarea extraction, plan comparison and export to GIS, plus release notes for versions 5.0.1 to 5.0.12 and help text on its configuration keys and tab-delimited file formats; the code appears to be C++, with a Visual Studio solution and CMake files. Coverage depends on the network loaded, typically a metropolitan region. The code is free to download; its licence was not read, and the SourceForge project page served a bot check to the cloud session. Caveats: the project has not been updated since 2014, the original transims.net site no longer answers, and preparing networks and demand is laborious. It supports transport network and evacuation studies, such as simulating traffic when bridges close after a flood or routing a city's evacuation in a hurricane. No related TRANSIMS record is catalogued.
